evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically 8.4→17.1→22.9→30.8 ppm during growth after stable ~7-8 ppm baseline
Tube pressure creeping up 3.04→3.27 Torr with Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
MFC flow on setpoint, so pressure rise is not from increased inlet flow

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, or a discriminating test (briefly cut Ar flow and watch pressure/O2 rise-rate) to distinguish an air in-leak from exhaust restriction.
